item.title: Drones find missing dogs alive after days in the cold
item.description: A heart-pounding search involving two family pets, missing for days during the latest Arctic blast, ended in a miracle. The dogs, Ella and Bebe, were found alive and moving after being lost in subzero temperatures, thanks to a unique rescue effort using drones.
